This company exhibits a very large scale of operations with over $13 billion in revenue, but operates on relatively thin margins (5% operating margin) and carries a highly leveraged capital structure with an equity multiplier of over 5.3x (total liabilities of $13.8 billion against $3.1 billion in equity). Furthermore, its short-term liquidity is pressured, as evidenced by a current ratio of 0.89 (current liabilities exceed current assets). These credit metrics—specifically the high leverage, weak liquidity, and low profitability despite large scale—are characteristic of a non-investment grade issuer with moderate default risk.

DECISION: BB-
